name: compliancecow-rules
description: Compliance rule management, automation, and control mapping for ComplianceCow.
long_description:
ComplianceCow Rules provides comprehensive compliance rule management capabilities. Create, configure, and execute automated compliance rules that map to control frameworks. Manage asset checks, schedule rule executions, generate documentation, and track rule publishing status.

Key capabilities:
- Rule creation and management with I/O mapping
- Control-to-rule attachment for automated compliance
- Asset check management and scheduling
- Design notes and README generation
- Rule execution with progress tracking
- Citation suggestions for control configurations
- Support ticket creation for compliance issues
